Team —

Quick sync to align on go/no-go for the Nordics launch (ETA: Sept 1). High level asks below — please reply with status + blockers by EOD Tuesday so I can compile for the QBR prep with Ops and Sales leadership.

Top-line asks (GTM, Enablement, Pricing, Docs, Support):
- GTM: final landing page + regional comms live? (owner: Markus)
- Enablement: training content and quickstart for partners / SEs (owner: Laura)
- Pricing: approved regional price list + billing terms (owner: Markus)
- Docs: localized install/FAQ + sample prompts (owner: Grace)
- Support: on-call coverage + escalation playbook (owner: Connor)

Attachments: nordic-launch-checklist.xlsx, initial-pricing-proposal.xlsx

Notes: OdinCloud (mikael.svensson) is the first partner; they need confirmation on support SLAs and a doc handoff plan. I want a one-slide exec summary for the QBR — 3 bullets: readiness, risks, ask.

Thanks,
Stephanie

Action items:
1) Legal: prepare SLA addendum template for partner (Laura to loop in Legal).

Hi Stephanie, Markus —

Appreciate the checklist. A couple of things from OdinCloud's side:
- Legal will need the SLA addendum draft by Aug 18 for internal review.
- We can accept 99.9% for production; dev/test can be best-effort but please note our procurement wants invoice terms (Net 30) clarified.
- For support: we will run a pilot with 9–5 CET support for the first two weeks and then move to a 24/7 escalation rota if all goes well.

Can Markus confirm the deployment region (we need Stockholm region confirmed to test latency).

Best,
Mikael Svensson
Partnerships Lead, OdinCloud
